title: SlipX car manifest
description: car.yaml: the manifest of a car directory. It names the files that describe the vehicle and nothing else; every actual parameter lives in one of them. Keeping the manifest empty of physics is what allows dynamics.yaml to be replaced by an identified set (P2) without touching anything else.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema this file is written against (SCH-01). An unknown major is refused; a known older minor is migrated.

name.description: Identifier for this car. Lower case, no spaces, so it can be a directory name, a ROS namespace and a registry key without transformation.

dynamics.description: Path to the dynamics file, relative to the car directory.

limits.description: Path to the actuator and electrical limits file, relative to the car directory.

sensors.description: Path to the sensor configuration, relative to the car directory. Optional at schema 0.1.0 because nothing consumes it until slipx_sense lands in P1.

provenance.description: Path to the provenance file, relative to the car directory. Required, not optional: an unlabelled parameter set is exactly what NFR-08 exists to prevent.

urdf.description: Path to the URDF or xacro owning frames, link geometry, inertias and sensor mount transforms. Optional at 0.1.0; it becomes load-bearing when slipx_ros needs a TF tree in P1. It owns nothing about dynamics, because it cannot express any of it.

tyres_dir.description: Directory holding local tyre files, relative to the car directory. Tyre references resolve here first and against the registry second (SCH-05). When absent the loader looks in 'tyres/' and reports the directory it used; that is a path convention, not a defaulted parameter.
